Your First API Call
The DeepSeek API uses an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic. By modifying the configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK or softwares compatible with the OpenAI/Anthropic API to access the DeepSeek API.

VALUE

https://api.deepseek.com

https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic
api_key

Models & Pricing
Model prices are listed in units of per 1M tokens. A token, the smallest unit of text that the model recognizes, can be a word, a number, or even a punctuation mark. We bill model usage based on the total number of input and output tokens by the model.
